participants.basis: Exactly two speakers exchange sustained objections and replies. Goff advances panpsychist and theistic interpretations; Folley independently challenges intrinsic-nature access, inference, mystical warrant, and fine-tuning. Folley explicitly disclaims physicalism and advocates pragmatic epistemic caution. No third speaker appears.
